title: Integrator
text: Integrate signal, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Wrapped state lower value} sets lower value for wrap state; {External reset} sets the reset states to their initial conditions, {Initial condition source} sets the option to set initial condition using external signal, {Initial condition} sets the initial state, {Limit output} limits block output values to specified, {Upper saturation limit} sets the upper limit, {Lower saturation limit} sets the lower limit, {Wrap state} enables wrapping of states, {Wrapped state upper value} sets the upper value for wrapped, {Show saturation port} enables saturation output port, {Show state port} enables state output port, {Absolute tolerance}, {Ignore limit and reset when linearizing} sets the option to use default reset and limit behavior for block during, {Enable zero-crossing detection} and {State Name (e.g., ’position’)} sets the assign unique name to each state. Values come from the instance.
